bolumlerimiz.title: Departments | Hacettepe University Faculty of Engineering
bolumlerimiz.description: The departments and graduate programs of Hacettepe University Faculty of Engineering.

bilgisayar.title: Computer Engineering
bilgisayar.desc: Offers a strong curriculum in artificial intelligence, software engineering and cybersecurity.

elektrik.title: Electrical and Electronics Engineering
elektrik.desc: Provides undergraduate and graduate education in power systems, telecommunications and embedded systems.

endustri.title: Industrial Engineering
endustri.desc: Offers an interdisciplinary education in production systems, optimization and data analytics.

cevre.title: Environmental Engineering
cevre.desc: Focuses on water and waste management, sustainability and environmental impact assessment.

jeoloji.title: Geological Engineering
jeoloji.desc: Specializes in earth sciences, mineral resources and the study of natural disaster risks.

maden.title: Mining Engineering
maden.desc: Provides education in mine operations, ore processing and drilling technologies.

gida.title: Food Engineering
gida.desc: Conducts research in food safety, processing technologies and biotechnology.

kimya.title: Chemical Engineering
kimya.desc: Has a strong laboratory infrastructure for process design, materials science and energy conversion.

nukleer.title: Nuclear Energy Engineering
nukleer.desc: A specialized department in nuclear energy systems, radiation safety and energy policy.

news.title: News From Our Faculty
news.lead: News to keep you informed and inspired — from research achievements to academic partnerships, from student accomplishments to campus life.
news.intro: From computer engineering to environmental engineering, from chemistry to nuclear energy, the Faculty of Engineering turns the research produced across its 9 departments into value for industry and society.
news.quote: Working with an interdisciplinary research vision since its founding, our Faculty continues to turn the knowledge produced by its faculty members and students into industry partnerships and new technologies.

item1.title: International AI Collaboration for the Faculty of Engineering
item1.desc: Our faculty signed a joint research protocol with three European universities in artificial intelligence and autonomous systems.

item2.title: 2026 Science and R&D Report in 12 Points
item2.desc: The annual report highlights the rise in our faculty's research output and the need for sustainable funding.

item3.title: Our Students Became Turkey Champions in a Robotics Competition
item3.desc: A team of Computer Engineering students won first place in the national robotics competition.

item4.title: Spring Semester Course Registration Calendar Published
item4.desc: 2025-2026 Spring semester course registrations will take place through the student information system between February 10-14.

item5.title: New Student Dormitory Opened at Beytepe Campus
item5.desc: The new 500-capacity dormitory building opened its doors with modern social areas and study halls.

item6.title: New Universities Added to the Erasmus+ Exchange Program
item6.desc: Our students can now join the exchange program at five new partner universities in Germany and Spain.

stats.title: Our Faculty in Numbers
stats.lead: We have a strong academic staff, a large student community and active research projects to turn our interdisciplinary research into tangible impact.
